svg.title: When the site goes down: from alert to lesson learned
svg.desc:
When the site goes down: from alert to lesson learned States shown: Live, Being built, In trial, Planned. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Detect: Error-rate alerts; Uptime checks; Unusual traffic (in trial). Owner: Reliability team - Respond: Page the on-call engineer; Open an incident channel; Assign roles automatically (being built). Owner: On-call rotation - Fix: Roll back; Add servers; Turn off a feature - Tell people: Status page; Support team; Email affected users (planned) - Learn: Timeline; Blameless review; Follow-up tasks. Owner: Incident lead Lines: - Detect -> Respond - Respond -> Fix - Respond -> Tell people, labeled "every 30 min" - Fix -> Learn - Tell people -> Learn, labeled "what users saw" Note: Example. An invented team's process. Every tool and status is made up.
